purpose: Self-contained custody of the governed Road LTL 1.4 source module so the successor RC does not depend on the divergent source branch/commit.
classification: GOVERNED_SOURCE_CUSTODY (source module; not a protected derivative; never deployed)
rules: The successor generator and every S8-6 verifier read THIS file, never the origin commit.
The file is excluded from deployment (.vercelignore: release/custody/).
A hash or byte change fails closed; a missing file fails closed.
